mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (code, name, start_date, end_date, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET name = #{name}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
